A '''Cavehopper''' was an amphibian predator from [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].

It had a frog-like body with a crocodile-like snout, and inhabited caves, sitting in a lair near the bones of its victims. Cavehoppers could see in the dark and attacked with their teeth and kicks. They were common in the mountains of the [[Krakana's Maw]] range.
